title: Gemini now turns your messy spreadsheets into interactive mini-apps
excerpt: Sheets canvas is rolling out now
content_html:
Published Aug 14, 2026, 2:24 AM EDT

I've been writing about Android since 2011, with a focus on device reviews, Samsung and Google Pixel hardware, and the latest happenings in the ecosystem. In my entire writing career, I've reviewed more than 75 Android phones.

Carrying both a Samsung or Pixel flagship and an iPhone as a daily driver provides me with deep insight into how Android works and how it compares to iOS.

I have been writing for Android Police since 2021, covering news, how-tos, and features. You can find my previous work on Neowin, AndroidBeat, Times of India, iPhoneHacks, MySmartPrice, and MakeUseOf.

When not working, I tend to mindlessly scroll through X, play with new AI models, or go on long road trips. You can reach out to me on X or drop a mail at rajesh@androidpolice.com.

Sign in to your Android Police account

Gemini has transformed the Google Sheets experience, making it easy to handle complex spreadsheet tasks. Google now wants to make the experience even better with Sheet canvas. As Google puts it, the feature will turn your spreadsheets in Google Sheets into custom, interactive "mini-apps."

The problem with Google Sheets is that it can become daunting to manage as the data grows. This also makes it difficult to find specific information quickly. Google is using the power of Gemini and mini-apps to solve this problem.

The company explains the feature as a "dynamic, read-write layer that sits directly on top of your spreadsheet data." So, you don't have to bother with columns and rows. You can use the mini-app to manage and navigate data in any way you want.

What makes mini-apps inside Google Sheets even more powerful is that you don't need any coding skills to create them. Gemini will do all the heavy lifting; you just need to describe what you want in natural language. Any changes you make in the mini-app will automatically reflect in the spreadsheet.

Even better, you can continue refining the mini-app as you go.

Use mini-apps in Sheets to track progress

For students juggling multiple subjects and deadlines, Google says Sheet canvas can double as an interactive study planner. They can use it to keep track of assignments, monitor their progress, set reminders, and get a clear overview of upcoming deadlines. Or, if you follow football, you can use Sheet canvas to build a command center for your fantasy football team. From there, you can track your team’s and players' performance, compare stats, and more.

If anything, mini-apps in Google Sheets can turn a messy project tracker into a clean dashboard that's far easier to manage.

The "Create canvas" option will appear in the Gemini sidebar inside a spreadsheet in Google Sheets. You can also find more information on how to use the feature in this Google support page.

Sheets canvas is rolling out globally to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. It is also available to Google Workspace users on Business, Enterprise, Standard, Plus, and the AI Pro for Education add-on. For now, the feature only works with spreadsheets in English.

自 2011 年以来，我一直在撰写有关 Android 的文章，重点关注设备评论、三星和 Google Pixel 硬件以及生态系统中的最新动态。 在我的整个写作生涯中，我评测过超过 75 款 Android 手机。

日常驾驶时同时携带三星或 Pixel 旗舰产品和 iPhone，让我能够深入了解 Android 的工作原理以及它与 iOS 的比较。

自 2021 年以来，我一直为 Android Police 撰写文章，内容涵盖新闻、操作方法和功能。 您可以在 Neowin、AndroidBeat、Times of India、iPhoneHacks、MySmartPrice 和 MakeUseOf 上找到我之前的作品。

不工作时，我倾向于无意识地浏览 X、玩新的人工智能模型，或者进行长途旅行。 您可以通过 X 联系我或发送邮件至 rajesh@androidpolice.com。

登录您的 Android Police 帐户

Gemini 改变了 Google 表格的体验，让您可以轻松处理复杂的电子表格任务。 Google 现在希望通过 Sheet canvas 提供更好的体验。 正如谷歌所说，该功能会将您在 Google Sheets 中的电子表格变成自定义的交互式“迷你应用程序”。

Google Sheets 的问题在于，随着数据的增长，管理起来会变得令人畏惧。 这也使得快速查找特定信息变得困难。 谷歌正在利用 Gemini 和迷你应用程序的力量来解决这个问题。

该公司将该功能解释为“直接位于电子表格数据之上的动态读写层”。 因此，您不必担心列和行。 您可以使用迷你应用程序以任何您想要的方式管理和导航数据。

让 Google 表格中的迷你应用变得更加强大的是，您不需要任何编码技能即可创建它们。 双子座会承担所有繁重的工作；你只需要用自然语言描述你想要的东西。 您在迷你应用程序中所做的任何更改都会自动反映在电子表格中。

更好的是，您可以随时继续完善迷你应用程序。

使用表格中的迷你应用来跟踪进度

谷歌表示，对于需要兼顾多个科目和截止日期的学生来说，Sheet canvas 可以兼作交互式学习计划工具。 他们可以使用它来跟踪作业、监控进度、设置提醒并清楚地了解即将到来的截止日期。 或者，如果您关注足球，则可以使用 Sheet canvas 为您的梦幻足球队构建指挥中心。 从那里，您可以跟踪球队和球员的表现、比较统计数据等等。

如果说有什么不同的话，那就是 Google 表格中的迷你应用程序可以将杂乱的项目跟踪器转变为更易于管理的干净仪表板。

“创建画布”选项将出现在 Google 表格电子表格内的 Gemini 侧边栏中。 您还可以在此 Google 支持页面中找到有关如何使用该功能的更多信息。

Sheets 画布正在全球范围内向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅者推出。 Google Workspace Business、Enterprise、Standard、Plus 和 AI Pro for Education 插件的用户也可以使用它。 目前，该功能仅适用于英文电子表格。
